hotels.title: Playful Design-Led Lyon Stay by Mama Shelter
hotels.description: Set in Lyon’s lively 7th arrondissement, this design-led retreat places you near the Rhône’s riverbanks, the Institut Lumière and the independent bars of Guillotière. Playful interiors by Philippe Starck pair bold colours with polished concrete, creating a distinctly contemporary base in one of the city’s most characterful quarters. Onsite, guests can dip into the outdoor pool, sip cocktails on the terrace and dine on generous homemade dishes at the restaurant. A short tram ride leads to Presqu’île’s elegant boutiques, Les Halles de Lyon Paul Bocuse and Vieux Lyon’s Renaissance lanes
